profile.headline: Foodie, Google Groupie, Microsoft drone
profile.summary:
Foodie who happens to dev web, desktop and mobile apps. 

A Microsoft drone. I see sharp ;)

A Google "groupie" highly interested in Google products and APIs...not mentioning them..it seems whatever I pick gets "killed by Google"...I mean sunsets should be pretty...

If it has commerce, it has my attention. A payment API is always something to tinker with. Hello Stripe, Paypal, Amazon Payments

I am a PC and I am a Mac. I run Windows on my MacBook Pro...and have a PC and Mac..still. 

My Mac doesn't have stickers.

Can't we all get along? VB.Net, C#, Javascript, Typescript, Ruby. All of it! Now I'm writing def...in C#..and semi-colons...in Ruby...should be ok..

Python... looks like Ruby.

Team Leadership. Listen. Mentor. Respect. Peers.

I eat APIs.

I serve APIs.

.Net Core + Docker + GitHub + Render. Done. Now there's real progress with paas/container apps. Exciting times. 

CI/CD? Keep it simple. Thank you Render. No cloud devops certification required.

Simplify. Everything. Spaghetti is great food, only.

Have we moved past leet code, hacker rank thingies yet? 

I will explore for an excellent adventure, or, an awesome crash and burn.

I wear GEEK, proudly. I think it's sexy.

How remote? 100% #remotework. Does it really matter where you were when you merged that buggy branch into main?

positions.title: Software Engineer, Integrations
positions.description:
Orion provides a software and services platform for financial advisors to manage clients’ accounts, risk assessments/evaluations, planning, etc. As an individual contributor of the Integrations team, I  build and maintain integrations with advisory firms and service providers of components of the platform (secure accounts data, documents exchange, storage, SSO, etc).

I work on, and collaborate with, internal and external teams on integrations with financial platforms and services APIs, Identity, data exchange, documents  (financial statements, trade confirmations, tax documents, etc.), SSO, implementation of new features, tech debt, upgrades, hardening, and bug fixes. Documenting, mentoring and training. I onboard, peer with, and guide, global team members.

Primarily backend  C#/.Net with a dash of front end Angular/Typescript.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
RAM manufactures and distributes device mounts (phones, tablets, industrial handhelds, laptops, etc) for consumers, industry and fleet operations.

Leading and managing a small web development team in a Ruby /Rails environment, supporting B2B and B2C ecommerce operations. Establishing technical goals, workflows and projects to meet and support sales and marketing web operations. Deployed measurable SEO and web site performance improvements (structured data, microdata, Schema.org, JSON+LD)  within 3 months. Introduced architectural development workflows - code reuse with internal Gems (private Github), Sprint retrospectives, Friday team learnings)

- Avalara Sales Tax ( Avatax ) integration ( Ruby/Rails , REST , API, MySQL, SQL Server )

- Stripe Payments API integration ( Ruby/Rails , REST , API, MySQL, SQL Server )

- Started and built internal Ruby Gems for team code reuse 

- Upgrading and building web and desktop applications ( Windows Forms, C#, .Net/Core, SQL Server,
MySQL , Ruby/Rails,ETL, YAML, XML, JSON, Bootstrap, Javascript/JQuery )

- A/B Testing with Google Optimize

- Custom Google Analytics tracking (events, etc)

- Worked on improving Web Accessibility compliance

- Wrote C# .Net app , Windows Service and Windows Scheduled Task that initially optimized thousands of images for web consumption, and continuously monitors new/modified image files and optimizing them

- Introduced Typescript to the team

- Introduced and helped adoption of VS Code to the team (from Sublime Text )

- Building/maintaining/upgrading legacy client side code using Typescript , REACT (from JQuery , Coffeescript , vanilla Javascript ) where possible.

- Web Application Firewall ( Cloudflare ) maintenance

- APM with New Relic

While originally known for professional instrument and audiophile cables, its most recognizable and successful brand was Beats By Dre (later acquired by Apple). • SLI Systems Search
• Global Product Serial Number Verification (redesign/re-architecture)
• Google Product Search

projects.title: RAM MOUNTS Google Manufacturer Center Implementation
projects.description:
Always an advocate of efficient workflows between businesses, data exchange workflows are key. In order to "introduce" this concept/mindset, I started with the goal of implementing Google Manufacturer Center feeds (XML).

· Review Google Manufacturer Schema
· Work with internal teams to identify internal sources of data to meet/map to schema
· Grunt work: ETL (relational databases, disparate data files: csv, yml, xls, etc)

Result: The effort proved both challenging and worthwhile.

· Critical business data errors were discovered and corrected (GTIN/UPC)
· More challenges were identified with an eye to future resolution
· A "core" data set is now in place
· Successful implementation of Google Manufacturer Center

This project is ongoing with the long view of efficient data interchange and integrations between business partners and 3rd party services.

projects.title: SEO, Site Optimization
projects.description:
Implemented well known SEO and optimization best practices and tools to dramatically increase search engine visibility of the RAM web site. Deployed automation to handle optimization of web resources (images) seamlessly without impacting workflows (from legacy resources and moving forward).

This project entailed rapidly groking a new platform - for myself, coming from an .Net/ASP.Net/Windows architecture, into a RoR, non-Windows platform, and successfully, seamlessly, integrating technologies such as JSON-LD and microdata markup within the first ~60 days.

Engaged the team in site-wide optimization efforts - refactoring legacy CSS, Javascript, image spriting. 

As part of the optimization work, deployed automation software (C#) to handle optimization of  ~70k images, from legacy files onward, without impacting resources nor disrupting workflows. Long view plug and play.

Concrete results of this ongoing project (Pagespeed Insights):
• Mobile score raised from 44 to 72
• Desktop score raised from 16 to 87
• Page load times reduced from ~4 secs to ~2 secs
• Page size reduced from ~8M to ~2M
• No of page requests reduced from ~200 to ~80
